claim_under_test: Controlled natural language preserves action order better than free prose
treatment: controlled natural language generated from same canonical plan
controlled_factors: provider/model/version; seed when supported; assets; duration; aspect; negative prompt
automatic_metrics: action-order accuracy; phase-boundary error; actor assignment
decision_rule: promote only if effect is positive with 95% CI excluding zero on primary metric

claim_under_test: Serialization format changes adherence after semantic content is held constant
treatment: same content serialized as YAML and XML
controlled_factors: same token content as closely as possible; model; seed; assets
automatic_metrics: schema parse; action-order; contact-time error; token count
decision_rule: no format doctrine unless replicated on at least two models

claim_under_test: A solved STN timeline improves causal order
controlled_factors: same actions; same durations; same provider
automatic_metrics: temporal contradiction rate; order accuracy; reaction-before-contact rate
decision_rule: accept when solved condition reduces contradictions by >=30% without quality loss >0.25/5

claim_under_test: Explicit contact records improve contact readability
treatment: contact record compiled through best available carrier
controlled_factors: same action; same camera; same seed/assets
automatic_metrics: contact-time error; minimum-distance proxy; reaction latency
decision_rule: provider-specific; promote only with significant improvement and no penetration increase

claim_under_test: Support constraints reduce foot sliding
automatic_metrics: foot-contact F1; root velocity during plant; foot-skate distance
decision_rule: accept if skate distance drops >=25% and human grounding rises >=0.5/5

claim_under_test: Camera compensation can improve perceived impact when physical contact control is weak
automatic_metrics: contact visibility; camera onset error; motion blur
decision_rule: label as perceptual compensation, never physical validation

claim_under_test: First/last keyframes improve endpoint adherence
automatic_metrics: start/end pose similarity; identity score; trajectory endpoint error
decision_rule: promote per provider/model contract only

claim_under_test: Dense prompts outperform compressed prompts only until a provider-specific saturation point
treatment: dense compiled prompt across 4 token budgets
automatic_metrics: adherence composite; ignored-control count; token count
decision_rule: select Pareto-optimal budget, not longest prompt

claim_under_test: Shot decomposition improves multi-action reliability
treatment: separate shot generations with persistent state handoff
controlled_factors: same total narrative; references; duration budget
automatic_metrics: action completion; identity drift; screen-side continuity
decision_rule: accept when completion/continuity gain exceeds edit seam penalty

claim_under_test: Numeric FACS tracks outperform descriptive expressions
treatment: numeric AU onset-apex-offset translated through same carrier
automatic_metrics: AU detector agreement; timing error; identity similarity
decision_rule: do not promote if automatic AU gain lacks blinded human gain

claim_under_test: Project-specific Laban vectors control movement quality better than qualitative words
controlled_factors: 1] project vectors compiled to matched text/reference
n_per_condition: same action and performer; no style changes
decision_rule: expert LMA ratings; inter-rater reliability
prerequisites: requires ICC or Krippendorff alpha threshold before claiming calibration

claim_under_test: Provider-specific compilation beats a generic prompt
automatic_metrics: unsupported-control rate; adherence; generation failure rate
decision_rule: promote adapter when loss report is complete and adherence improves

claim_under_test: Round-trip minimal repair is more efficient than full regeneration
controlled_factors: same initial failed output; same budget
automatic_metrics: iterations to pass; fields changed; token/cost; regression count
decision_rule: accept if pass rate improves and collateral regressions drop

claim_under_test: Reference-image identity binding reduces actor swaps
automatic_metrics: actor swap count; face/body identity embedding drift
decision_rule: contract-specific; no universal identity-lock claim

claim_under_test: Persistent scene state improves cross-shot continuity
treatment: state snapshots and transition validation between beats
automatic_metrics: object ownership errors; screen-side flips; wardrobe/light state changes
decision_rule: accept if state violations fall >=50%

claim_under_test: Explicit last-frame conditioning improves continuation
automatic_metrics: boundary pose error; velocity discontinuity; identity drift
decision_rule: separate last-frame from extension capability

claim_under_test: Loss-report severity predicts output failure
treatment: controls classified and required losses fail closed
automatic_metrics: precision/recall of predicted failures; calibration error
decision_rule: accept when high-severity loss predicts failure with calibrated probability

claim_under_test: Seed variance can overwhelm prompt-format effects
automatic_metrics: variance components; effect size; CI width
decision_rule: no single-render conclusions; report intraclass variance

claim_under_test: Re-extraction is accurate enough for selected automatic repair metrics
controlled_factors: controlled filmed, synthetic, and generated clips
automatic_metrics: MPJPE; contact F1; phase error; actor swaps; calibration
decision_rule: only metrics meeting predeclared error bounds may trigger automatic repair

claim_under_test: Hybrid graph retrieval improves constraint recall over token overlap
controlled_factors: same query set; same context budget
automatic_metrics: node/edge/path recall; contradiction recall; citation accuracy; token cost
decision_rule: promote only if recall and faithfulness improve without >25% token increase

claim_under_test: Camera-body disentanglement improves motion evaluation
treatment: world/body motion estimated after camera solve
automatic_metrics: root trajectory error; camera path error; false movement attribution
decision_rule: required before camera compensation auto-repair

claim_under_test: Contact-aware scoring improves interaction diagnosis
treatment: typed contact graph with visibility/support/reaction links
automatic_metrics: contact F1; reaction timing; penetration; false impact rate
decision_rule: promote only after multi-person and occlusion strata pass
